Charleston city.name: City of Charleston
Charleston city.description: Incorporated City of Charleston, SC. Census TIGER 4513330. Spans peninsula, West Ashley, James Island annexes, Daniel Island, Cainhoy. Combined millage 313.6 (TD 34/35/36/52/63/71/72/99) + SC 4%/6% ratios + 0.00090 LOST credit.

note: Sum of ACRES_CAL overcounts because condos store the building footprint as each unit's geometry. Polygon area is the right per-acre denominator for cross-area comparison.
